features.name: p_neg_max_z
features.description: strongest pressure deficit: max over pressure residual sensors of -mean z (10 s)

features.name: p_pos_max_z
features.description: strongest pressure excess: max of +mean z (10 s)

features.name: p_n_dev
features.description: number of pressure sensors with |mean z (10 s)| > 3

features.name: p_isolation
features.description: |z|max / (|z|second + 1) over pressure sensors

features.name: p_sign_consistency
features.description: share of deviating pressure sensors with the sign of the strongest one

features.name: cusum_neg_max
features.description: max negative CUSUM / h over pressure sensors

features.name: cusum_pos_max
features.description: max positive CUSUM / h over pressure sensors

features.name: mb_z
features.description: normalised integral mass-balance residual (max over metered groups)

features.name: flow_res_max_abs_z
features.description: max |mean z (10 s)| over flow residual sensors

features.name: flow_pattern
features.description: mean z of inflow meters minus mean z of outflow meters (leak-like if > 0)

features.name: pump_cmd_change
features.description: max |change of pump speed command| in the window

features.name: valve_cmd_change
features.description: max |change of valve opening command| in the window

features.name: time_since_cmd
features.description: min(time since last public command, window) / window

features.name: temp_change
features.description: max |change| of measured inlet temperatures in the window

features.name: wc_change
features.description: max |change| of measured inlet water cut in the window

features.name: frac_missing
features.description: share of missing samples of residual sensors in the window

features.name: max_data_age
features.description: max age of the last good sample among residual sensors, capped at the window

features.name: observer_disagreement
features.description: mean |prediction fixed - prediction measured-property| / sigma over pressure sensors

features.name: wave_onsets
features.description: number of pressure sensors with a sharp negative onset in the window

features.name: noise_ratio_max
features.description: max ratio of high-rate residual std (10 s) to its calibration value

features.name: jump_max_z
features.description: max |mean(last 5 s) - mean(previous 5 s)| / sigma over pressure sensors
